The '''Battle of the Drexel system''' was a battle during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that occurred in the [[Drexel system/Legends|Drexel system]]. In this region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], an elite Imperial fighter squadron had been launching devastating hit-and-run attacks on Republic convoys. Finally the squadron had been tracked to an [[Drexel asteroid field|asteroid field]] in the Drexel system. So the Republic Command organized an ambush using the elite [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron, supported by [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]]. The Republic fought very well destroying most, if not all, of the Sith forces there.

==Behind the scenes==
This is an upgraded version of the [[Battle of the Archenar asteroid field]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
